result.content:
# SPARQL query: Cultural points of interest in Alicante (Q11959), Spain (Q29).
# Returns item identifiers and labels for cultural POIs that have coordinates (p625).
# Cultural POI types: art gallery (Q181800), library (Q3185), monument (Q130646),
# museum (Q33506), theatre building (Q153042).
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX psv: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statementvalue/>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>
SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?coord ?coordValue ?type ?typeLabel
WHERE {
  # Constrain to Spain (wd:Q29) and Alicante (wd:Q11959)
  ?item wdt:P17 wd:Q29 ;
        wdt:P127 wd:Q11959 ;
        p:P625 ?coord ;
        wdt:P31/wdt:P279* ?type.

  # Coordinate value of the p625 statement
  ?coord psv:P625 ?coordValue.

  # Keep only the configured cultural POI types
  FILTER (?type IN (wd:Q181800, wd:Q3185, wd:Q130646, wd:Q33506, wd:Q153042))

  # Human-readable labels for the item and its type
  SERVICE wikibase:label {
    bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en,es".
    ?item rdfs:label ?itemLabel.
    ?type rdfs:label ?typeLabel.
  }
}
LIMIT 100
